heading: Connect your phone
intro: Pair Mika once. Forward CLI and MCP requests to your phone.
ownerHint: Read owner-key on your server. This key manages pairing; use the phone’s access token in your clients.
codeHint: Expires in five minutes. Use once.
phoneHint: In Mika: Settings → Connect a computer → Remote. Enter this gateway and code, then allow remote access.
accessBody: Use the same phone access token for LAN, remote CLI and MCP. The gateway does not issue, check or store it.
privacyBody: HTTPS ends at this gateway, so it can read forwarded headers, requests and results. Phone lock credentials stay on the phone.
confirmBody: The remote connection will close. The access token on your phone stays unchanged. Pair again to restore forwarding.
codeCreated: Enter this code in Mika to pair your phone.
revoked: Phone unpaired. Remote forwarding is off.
alreadyPaired: A phone is already paired. Unpair it before creating a new code.
invalidOwner: The owner key is incorrect. Check the key file on your server.
invalidOrigin: This request came from another site. Open the gateway directly.
invalidRequest: This request could not be completed. Reload and try again.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
storageError: Couldn’t save pairing. Check the server data directory.
confirmHint: Enter the owner key again to confirm unpairing.
